scientific_integrity: The rank enumeration has a self-contained Pfaffian-matching proof and a standalone exhaustive verifier. Earlier fixed-orientation skew-rank and tree/cycle character results are credited; neither independent audit nor priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Graphs are finite connected simple unicyclic graphs only.
Rank enumeration holds for every finite field; character formula is asserted for odd prime powers only.
The exact support formula may require exponential-time evaluation.
Possible undiscovered equivalent weighted-matrix enumeration remains an originality risk.
Finite tests do not prove infinite statements.
title: A factorized Pfaffian correction for graphical groups of every unicyclic graph
